after.card: Nixtamalization cooks and steeps maize in an alkaline solution, commonly containing food-grade lime (calcium hydroxide). Washing and milling turn the kernels into dough for foods such as tortillas. Lime cooking increases calcium content; processing also makes niacin more available.

after.card: Chöd is a Buddhist offering practice directed at cutting self clinging. In Lama Zopa’s teaching, visualized offerings of the body to spirits are connected with examining the apparently inherent self. Fear becomes an occasion to investigate that self’s supposed independent existence.

evidence.note: The body feast offering in Chöd is visualized.

after.label: Chöd
after.learning_takeaway: Connect offering practice with investigation of self clinging.

relations.note: The teaching situates chöd within Buddhist charity and wisdom.
